title: NYRR Race Procedures — Arrival, Bag Check and Corral Entry
claims: Runners who picked up their number in advance should arrive at least 60 minutes before the race start to leave time for bag check, toilets and getting into the start corral.
Runners should be in their start corral at least 10 minutes before the start; bib pickup closes 10 minutes after the start time.
Picking up the race number in advance is recommended to save time on race morning.
